module: Flowgraph node "Set Vehicle Flowgraph" (once_instant). Launches a custom flowgraph (fgFile) for a traffic vehicle via veh.role:setupFlowgraph(fgFile, varData). Custom input pins (types string, number, bool, any, table, vec3, quat, color; not flow) are saved and passed as variables to the flowgraph. Ideal for custom AI roles and actions. On reset, the role's flowgraph is removed (role:clearFlowgraph).

init.desc: Initializes the node's internal state at creation (called by the flowgraph engine).

onNodeReset.desc: Removes the role flowgraph of the remembered vehicle (clearFlowgraph) and forgets vehId.

workOnce.desc: Copies the values of all non-fixed input pins into varData and calls veh.role:setupFlowgraph(fgFile, varData) for vehicle vehId.
